boards.name: Film brainstorming
boards.description: Develop a new film idea from a spark: premises, what-ifs, characters, references and the questions that will shape the first draft.

cards.title: Brainstorm: a film about a night-ferry crossing
cards.body: Development session. Quantity first, judgement later — then vote and pick one premise to take into a treatment.

cards.title: How to use this template
cards.body: Add every idea as its own card in “Sparks”. When the session ends, drag the strongest three into “Contenders” and connect them to the references that inspired them.

cards.title: Where it started
cards.body: A six-hour overnight ferry. Lorry drivers, a hen party, a family moving country, a man who boarded without a ticket. Nobody can leave until morning.

cards.title: The boat
cards.body: Photo: Dusk, Atlantic Ocean, Nags Head, Outer Banks, North Carolina (14261729728) — Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA. CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: What if…
cards.body: …the ship’s engine fails mid-crossing and the radio goes quiet?

cards.title: What if…
cards.body: …a child goes missing and every passenger is a suspect?

cards.title: What if…
cards.body: …two strangers meet every month on the same crossing — and we only see those nights?

cards.title: What if…
cards.body: …the night steward is the only person who knows the boat will not arrive?

cards.title: Image
cards.body: A dance floor with no one on it, rolling with the sea.

cards.title: Image
cards.body: Trucks chained in the hold, their engines ticking as they cool.

cards.title: Character
cards.body: A retired captain travelling as a passenger, unable to stop listening to the engines.

cards.title: Sound
cards.body: The PA chime that means nothing — and then something.

cards.title: Corridors that repeat
cards.body: Photo: Interiör, Stena Danica, corridor, 20230410, pic 17 — AleWi. CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: The horizon that never arrives
cards.body: Photo: US Navy 021102-N-0000W-001 Lightning fills the horizon, and lights up the flight deck and air wing aircraft parked on the ship's forward elevator and bow — U.S. Navy photo by Lt. Troy Wilcox.. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: Films and books to revisit
cards.body:
- Bottle films set on trains and ships
- Stories told over a single night
- Short stories about strangers who only meet in transit

cards.title: A — The missing child
cards.body: Thriller. High concept, clear engine, but familiar.

cards.title: B — Twelve crossings
cards.body: Romance in fragments. Fresh structure; harder to sell.

cards.title: C — The captain
cards.body: Character drama with a slow-burn mystery. Strong lead role.

items.text: Who is the protagonist and what do they want tonight?
What is at stake by morning?
Why does it have to be this ship, this night?
Who would star — and who would produce?
